findings.title: Potential Prototype Pollution via Object.assign/spread
findings.description: Several areas of the code use spread operators and manual object manipulation on user-supplied options without filtering dangerous properties like `__proto__`.
steps_to_exploit: Attacker provides a malicious options object with a `__proto__` property.
The object is spread or merged into `kDefaultOptions` or other configurations.
Prototype pollution occurs, affecting all objects of that type across the application.
findings.impact: Global application state manipulation leading to denial of service or code execution.
